body.description: SAL, a teenage boy scavenger hero of post-collapse Texas: messy brown hair, worn leather cap with brass goggles pushed up, red bandana, tan work jacket with shearling collar, patched denim trousers, worn boots, tool pouch on belt. 1990s 16-bit console JRPG overworld sprite, chibi 2.5 heads tall, bold black outline, limited palette, crisp cel shading. single character, full body, standing, facing the viewer, game sprite, transparent background
